implemented_change.summary: LLMIntentPlanner now treats METRIC_NOT_FOUND on questions that explicitly contain a supported metric id surface as a bounded typed retry signal. It re-runs the same structured parser and still fails fast with METRIC_NOT_FOUND if retry cannot produce a valid supported intent. Unsupported KPI questions remain single-call typed failures.

next_optimization_target.rationale: The eval cannot complete while one supported explicit GMV question can fatal before trace creation. The fix must keep the LLM intent boundary and add bounded typed retry, not local default metric substitution.

known_risks: If the retry predicate is too broad, unsupported metrics could waste attempts; tests must prove unsupported KPI still raises METRIC_NOT_FOUND after one call.
